We are submitting a Partner Center referral for Winget Systems — they have indicated strong interest in a proof-of-concept for your Dedicated offering and want to engage our field sellers for a co-sell motion. I attached the PartnerCenter_referral_guidelines.pdf and a starter account mapping (Winget_account_map.xlsx) with the referral.

Quick asks from Microsoft Partner GTM:
- Can Redwood confirm the primary field seller who should be associated with this referral in Partner Center?
- Please verify account owners for the named accounts in the mapping (especially WING-ENT-01 and WING-ENT-03).
- Would Redwood prefer Microsoft to route this to regional sellers (East/West) or to a single named seller for continuity?

If you can return a short mapping (field seller + internal Redwood SDR/AE contact) we can accept and begin the co-sell enablement workflow. I expect Partner Center referral ID to appear by end of day once you confirm.

Attachments: Winget_account_map.xlsx (spreadsheet), PartnerCenter_referral_guidelines.pdf (doc)

Best,

Daniel — thanks for the intro and the files.

I attached our initial account->seller map (RDW_Winget_mapping_v1.xlsx) with proposed field-seller ownership. High level:

- I'll cover strategic account coordination and exec motion (ownership for the renewal/contract thread).
- Monica Patel will be the technical lead and will take point on the POC/vendor onboarding calls.

We prefer to associate a single named seller for continuity (Marissa) but are fine with Microsoft routing to regional sellers if there's an existing account owner on your side. Please confirm the Partner Center referral ID once it's created so we can link it to our HubSpot deal.

I've included a HubSpot link to the opportunity for reference: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234562/deal/DEAL-7890

Next steps we propose:
1) Daniel: register referral in Partner Center and share the referral id (PC-REF-xxxxx).
2) Marissa/Monica: align with Winget stakeholders and schedule initial co-sell call.
3) Karthik: I will prepare an outline of the POC success criteria for the co-sell call.

Thanks — sending the updated mapping now.

—Karthik
